textos.As opiniões divergem diretamente sobre a: Opinions diverge directly on the conclusion of the script: while most of those who recommend it consider the ending of the plot striking and engaging, nearly all of those who do not recommend it judge that the closing twist is predictable and loses its force.
textos.Várias reviews deste grupo relatam tédio: Several reviews in this group report boredom and sleepiness during much of the screening, saying the story is slow to get going and that almost nothing happens until the final minutes, which makes the experience drag.
textos.Este grupo considera que o desfecho é fá: This group considers the ending easy to anticipate and not very impactful, with some saying they knew what would happen long before the scene arrived, which they say compromised the experience.
textos.Algumas reviews apontam falta de vínculo: Some reviews point to a lack of connection with the protagonists, shallow supporting characters and unconvincing performances, with specific criticism of the two detectives' work.
textos.Há queixas de que a investigação avança: There are complaints that the investigation advances through coincidences and script conveniences, with obvious clues, rushed resolutions and a plot considered unoriginal.

textos.Algumas reviews criticam o excesso de ni: Some reviews criticize the excess of urban nihilism repeated to exhaustion and judge that the bleak message is neither well built nor developed, coming across as misanthropic or empty.
textos.Várias reviews medianas reclamam que o f: Several middling reviews complain that the film is slow to get going, with a dragging first half that almost makes them switch off, and that it only improves in the home stretch.
textos.Este grupo destaca que o desfecho era pr: This group stresses that the ending was predictable from early on, or that the resolution felt abrupt and did not match the expectation created.
textos.As reviews medianas elogiam a dupla prin: Middling reviews praise the lead duo and the villain, but some consider Brad Pitt's performance disappointing or unconvincing.
textos.O grupo considera a premissa dos sete pe: The group considers the seven deadly sins premise creative, but feels the script does not deepen the ideas and leaves the investigation superficial.
textos.A ambientação sombria e chuvosa, a direç: The dark, rainy setting, the art direction and the cinematography are frequently cited as the strongest points by this group.
textos.Algumas reviews medianas criticam a tram: Some middling reviews criticize the police plot as clichéd, with little real detective work and twists that fail to convince.
textos.As atuações de Morgan Freeman e Brad Pit: The performances of Morgan Freeman and Brad Pitt are frequently praised for their chemistry and intensity, with emphasis on the dynamic between the two detectives.

textos.Dirigido por David Fincher e lançado em: Directed by David Fincher and released in 1995, Seven is a crime and mystery police thriller. In the plot, Detective William Somerset is about to retire when he takes on one last case alongside the newly transferred David Mills, beginning the hunt for a criminal who chooses his victims to represent the seven deadly sins.
textos.A experiência do longa é estruturada sob: The experience of the film is built on a dense, somber urban setting, leading the investigation through a measured rhythm that follows the investigators' procedures in detail.
textos.Os diferentes grupos avaliados abordam e: The different groups evaluated address exactly the same aspects of the work and agree on what it presents, diverging fundamentally in the verdict on how these elements work. In the vast majority of ratings (~93%), a significant share highlights the cast's striking performances, while a good portion praises the story's impactful ending. In addition, a considerable number emphasize the dark, immersive atmosphere built by the production.
textos.Em contrapartida, para quem se posiciona: By contrast, for those who sit at a minimal fraction of ratings (~6%), about half of the accounts point to a slow pace and dragging parts, many consider the ending predictable or anticlimactic and several praise the performances but bring specific reservations about the result. Finally, from the perspective of an even smaller fraction of ratings (~1%), many again criticize the slow, dragging pace of the narrative, a good portion judge the final twist predictable and weak, and a portion point to weak performances combined with a lack of character development.
